decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template sits close to the core hosting offer and costs little to maintain, and its value to agencies is still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping open.
The responsive template was only mentioned briefly on the website, but upkeep is cheap and it complements the hosting service, so there is no evidence yet that justifies abandoning it.
Premium support fits the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock service strategy and creates recurring revenue at low incremental cost, so keeping it is clearly worthwhile.
The version management tool has its own page and builds on the firm's tooling that reduces recurring operational work, so it shows commitment and strategic value worth further investment.

The GDPR data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but demand after GDPR is still uncertain and keeping a web tool online is cheap, so the option should stay open until results show its value.
